content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 86. साधु &c.—The word वृत्त has a double application", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "here; as applied to the ball साधुवृत्त means ( साधु यथा तथा वृत्तः )", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "well-rounded, perfectly spherical; in the other case it means ‘of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "virtuous conduct, whose course of actions is well-regulated.’ Cf.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "‘वृत्ते स्थितस्याधिपतेः प्रजानाम् Rag. V. 33.’ अस्थायिन्य.—not abiding,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "short-lived. The Fig.s are अर्थान्तरन्यास and श्लेष.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 87. शृङ्ग—The top or peak of a mountain. गुरु—great,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "stupendous. विषम—विगतं विरुद्धं वा समम्; lit. uneven surface; न कृतः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "शीलविलयः—i. e. one should value character above every thing", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "else. Cf. मनस्वी म्रियते कामं कार्पण्यं न तु गच्छति.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 88 तस्य जलायते—तस्य towards him; in his case. जलायते", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "&c. are denominative verbs, formed by adding य् in the sense of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "‘ acts like that; ’ see com ; and are conjugated in the Atmane-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "pada. कुल्यायते—acts like a canal. i. e. assumes the narrowness of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "a canal. कुरङ्गायते—becomes tame like a deer. माल्यगुण—a wreath", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "of flowers, a garland. पीयूषवर्षायते—produces the effects of a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "shower of nectar.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 89. उपचीयते-increases, waxes. The root चि with उप,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "pass. means to grow in bulk, to thrive, as अपाच means to", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "decrease in bulk. सन्तप्यन्ते—are not grieved. विप्लुताः—over-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "powered by difficulties. न ते विपदा—is a better reading being", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "easier.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": true, "note": "Line 3 has अपाच (for अपचि); transcribed as printed."}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 90. नेता—guide, adviser. Cf. अमात्ये नेतरि सुलभमेतत्कुमारस्य", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "Mud. II. बृहस्पति—The spiritual adviser and counsellor of Indra.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "For derivation see sl. 34. अनुग्रहः किल हरेः—who, as is well known,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "( किल ) enjoys the favour of Hari. ऐरावतः—इरा आपः सन्त्यास्मिन्", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "इरावान् तत्र भवः (अण् ); lit. sprung from water. The name of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "Indra’s elephant obtained at the churning of the milky ocean.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "ऐश्वर्यबल—may be taken as a Tat. or a Dwandwa. The latter", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "is preferable. ऐश्वर्य—means here the accompaniments of royalty.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "भग्नः had to yield, was routed. दैवशरणम् v. l.—A poetical license.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "The poet’s meaning is दैवं शरणं ( रक्षिता ) वरं, and so the two", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "words can not be compounded. As it stands we may explain", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "दैवं शरणं दैवशरणम् । धिक् धिक् &c.—This may be taken in two", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "( 33 )", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r7", "type": "other", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "3", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5", "u6"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "86", "label": "Sl. 86", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "87", "label": "Sl. 87", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "88", "label": "Sl. 88", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "89", "label": "Sl. 89", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u6", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "90", "label": "Sl. 90", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r6"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
